result.description: A fictional high-contrast flash module designed for archival badge systems and field kiosks, the Orion Sable Thunderkey pairs a compact sealed housing with USB 3.2 Gen 1 connectivity and a 48GB NAND package. It is optimized for quick offline data handoff, rugged handling, and simple plug-and-play deployment in industrial terminals.
result.title: Orion Sable 48GB Thunderkey USB3.2 Flash Module
